filters._note: Fast filters: every value is already in the loaded tables; the Analysis server narrows rows, instantly, per reader. column = the table column they match. Any filter can be fast or slow: make it slow (parameters) only when changing it means querying the source again.

parameters._note: Slow filters: any choice whose data has to be pulled on its own (a region of a huge table, a snapshot month, a scenario). Changing one in the app re-runs Pipeline/run_all.py after a confirmation; one value for everyone. Fixed list: {label, default, options: [...]}; month ends: {label, type: month_end, default: latest, options: {month_ends: 12}}. The value is recorded in Data/Current/manifest.json. See the dashboard-work skill, references/data.md.

pricing._note: Approximate cost display only. Claude Haiku 5.5 list prices, USD per million tokens.
